_about: Skyscrapers layer (150 m+). engine/fetch_skyscrapers.py fetches the Wikipedia list; engine/skyscrapers.py builds docs/chicago/data/skyscrapers.geojson. Facts below are our own wording, checked against the sources noted.
wiki: List of tallest buildings in Chicago

open._rule: A tower listed with this year's date is drawn hollow (under construction) unless marked true here: it must be open for occupancy, not just topped out. Checked October 10, 2026.

Willis Tower: Tallest building in the world for almost 25 years, 1974–1998
Still called the Sears Tower by many Chicagoans
875 North Michigan Avenue: The first building outside New York to reach 1,000 ft
Tallest building completed anywhere in the world in the 1960s
St. Regis Chicago: Tallest building in the world designed by a woman (Jeanne Gang)
